evidenceKind: compact immutable extract of independently validated selected Core+Mac receipt

atExtract.ownerScopeDefinition: All Sources, Core tests, Mac target Shared/Mac/WebResources and MacTests/TestSupport plus the three explicit shared test sources from Applications/project.yml; iPad target paths and unrelated UIKit tests are separate.

checks: real inventory resolution and machine execution IDs
balanced Swift case events and complete native summary

toolchains.swift:
Apple Swift version 6.4 (swiftlang-6.4.0.34.1 clang-2100.3.34.1)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx27.0.0

duration.scope: Runner test durations; no interactive/system performance measure

boundaries: This is the exact historical v9 whole-source snapshot independently validated before subsequent iPad-only semantic fixes.
Current extraction confirms unchanged Core/Mac owner inputs; it does not reissue v9 for a changed whole tree.
No iPad device execution, gesture, system frame/CPU/GPU/RSS measure or all104 acceptance is claimed.
The iPhoneOS semantic build is a separate build-only route; its later result is not included here.
Earlier v5-v8 failed/interrupted aggregate routes stay failed/incomplete; their subsets do not certify those whole routes.
Large inventory/source manifests, compiled products and xcresult binaries stay only in the original evidence; the extract retains their exact original hashes.
